content.title: Personalized Astrology & Natal Chart Readings in Kennebunk, Maine | The Fifth Om — The Fifth Om, holistic wellness spa
content.text: Soulful Astrology SessionA focused, personalized astrology reading designed to offer clarity and guidance.What’s Included: • Natal chart interpretation • Sun, Moon, and Rising sign analysis • Key planetary placements explained • Insight into current life themes • Intuitive channeling • Optional tarot/oracle card pullIdeal For: • First-time astrology clients • Life transitions • Relationship or career clarity • Spiritual growth and self-understandingPlease Bring:Your full birth date, exact birth time, and birth location. If the exact time (or within 10 minutes) isn’t known, then interpretation can be discussed based on estimation. This session is based on Western Tropical Astrology using placidus house system. 30 min session: $3760 min session: $67 In-Depth Soulful Astrology SessionA comprehensive and thoughtfully prepared natal chart experience designed for deeper exploration and long-term reflection.Prior to your session, a detailed 8–10 page written natal chart summary is prepared exclusively for you. This personalized document serves as the foundation for our time together and becomes a keepsake you may revisit for years to come.During your private session, we explore the most meaningful placements within your chart, including your Sun, Moon, Rising sign, inner planets, and other significant influences shaping your personality and life path. Interpretive guidance is woven throughout, along with intuitive insight as it naturally arises.To close the experience, space is held for a one- or two-card pull from your choice of tarot or oracle deck. You will also receive a printed Astrology Basics Guide to take home, allowing you to continue reflecting and building your understanding beyond the session.What’s Included: • Personalized 8–10 page written natal chart summary (prepared in advance) • In-session review of key chart placements • Interpretation of core personality themes and life influences • Intuitive insights • Optional tarot or oracle card integration • Printed Astrology Basics GuideIdeal For: • Clients seeking a deeper, more comprehensive understanding • Those wanting a written chart summary to revisit • Significant life transitions or long-term planning • Individuals ready for expanded self-explorationPlease note: Please allow 2 weeks prior to date of session for Nicole to complete your natal chart summary (if you’re booking within 2 weeks of the appointment date, please choose the above option, Soulful Astrology Session). Upon booking, you can provide your date of birth, location of birth, and time of birth. This session is based on Western Tropical Astrology using placidus house system. 30 min session: $13760 min session: $167 What to ExpectYour astrology session is a private, thoughtfully curated experience designed to create space for reflection and insight. Within a calm and supportive setting, we explore the deeper patterns, timing, and themes influencing your life.Each reading is personalized to meet you where you are, whether you are seeking clarity around a transition, confirmation of your inner knowing, or a deeper understanding of your life path.Rather than prediction, these sessions focus on awareness. Astrology serves as a lens for perspective — illuminating strengths, cycles, and opportunities so you may move forward with greater intention and alignment. The Fifth Om offers personalized astrology readings and natal chart interpretations in Kennebunk, Maine. Sessions are available by appointment and designed to complement our holistic wellness offerings.
